<!--
The AASM v3 numbers in this project were triangulated from secondary sources, because the manual is
paywalled and was never read. The Periodicity Index has two contradictory formulations circulating
in its own author's publications, and this project picked one and documented the choice. If you have
the primary texts, you can settle questions that no amount of further reading settles.
-->

**The rule, as this project implements it** — with the file, and the line in `docs/03-algorithm.md`
or `docs/02-science.md` that states it.

**The rule as it is actually published** — with the source, and the passage if you can quote it.

**What changes if you are right.** Some of these move a number by a few percent; at least one
(whether a series breaks on a short interval) changes the result substantially.
